item.title: Dr Kamal hospitalised with serious illness
item.description: Veteran politician and one of the framers of Bangladesh's Constitution, Dr. Kamal Hossain, has been admitted to Square Hospital due to serious lung-related complications.According to a press release from Gono Forum, the party Dr. Hossain founded, he was admitted on Friday morning and is currently under close medical observation. item.title: Zimbabwe bring back Taylor, Cremer for T20 World Cup

item.title: 2 killed as 6.5-magnitude earthquake hits Mexico City

item.title: Trump threatens Iran over protest crackdown as deadly unrest flares
item.description: US President Donald Trump threatened on Friday to come to the aid of protesters in Iran if security forces fired on them, days into unrest that has left several dead and posed the biggest internal threat to Iranian authorities in years."We are locked and loaded and ready to go," he said in a social media post. item.title: Operation Devil Hunt Phase-2: 510 held, 6 firearms seized nationwide
item.description: Law enforcement agencies arrested 510 individuals across the country in the last 24 hours under the ongoing nationwide drive ‘Operation Devil Hunt Phase-2’. item.title: Cold wave likely from Tuesday, temperature may drop to 4°C
item.description: Dense fog covered the capital, as long as the country at the very beginning of the year, and it may persist across the country for the next more days.Temperatures may fall as low as 4 degrees Celsius, according to the Meteorological Office.

item.title: NBR registers 131,000 new VAT payers in Dec
item.description: The National Board of Revenue (NBR) registered 131,000 new value-added tax (VAT) payers in December through a special nationwide campaign aimed at expanding the VAT net and strengthening domestic revenue mobilisation.The achievement followed the observance of VAT Day on December 10 and VAT Week from December 10 to 15, 2025.This year's VAT Day theme 'Register on time, pay VAT properly' highlighted the government's emphasis on compliance, transparency and timely registration.In line with the theme

item.title: 30th trade fair opens at Purbachal venue
item.description: 30th Dhaka International Trade Fair (DITF) – 2026 was formally inaugurated at its permanent venue, the Bangladesh-China Friendship Exhibition Centre (BCFEC) in Purbachal area under Rupganj upazila of Narayanganj district on Saturday morning.The fair was inaugurated around 10:30 AM, marking another milestone in Bangladesh’s flagship trade exposition.
